name: Mapped & Managed
tagline: Teach it clearly. Track it simply.
description: Structured-literacy and special-education tools for literacy interventionists, reading specialists, and SPED case managers. Word mapping, decodable reading, IEP documentation, and caseload systems that do the busywork for you.
author: Greg
_comment_pinterest: After you create the Pinterest Business account and start the domain claim, Pinterest gives you a verification code. Paste ONLY the code value here (the part inside content="..."). Leave empty until then.
_comment_kit: Each FREE product has its own dedicated Kit form (see the 'kit' field on each free entry in products.json) — its own redirect-to-that-product's-TPT-URL setting and its own incentive/welcome email, both configured directly in Kit. This 'kitGeneral' form is optional and separate: a plain newsletter opt-in used only for the 'join the list' nudge on paid product pages. If left blank, paid pages just show a link to /free-tools/ instead.
